responsibility: Defines the rs6000 driver-side default option-spec machinery that turns configure-time defaults such as --with-cpu, --with-tune, --with-abi, and --with-float into conditional command-line specs. It centralizes how 32-bit versus 64-bit multilib modes choose -m32/-m64 or AIX variants, and supplies fallback definitions like OPTION_GLIBC so the rest of the backend can use these defaults uniformly across different operating-system subtargets.
